lastText: The Night EndsA House of Many RoomsNew Ending Discovered · 1 / 15A COUNT FROM THE EAST TAKES A HOUSE IN ANTWERPThe steamer for Antwerp leaves on the ebb with eight passengers, four names and a great deal of baggage. The hunters reach the quay a quarter of an hour late. By the time they think to search the ships, you are in the Scheldt, under a name they do not know. In Antwerp there is a good house with a chapel. It has a long table, which you set every night for people who do not eat, and a hall, in which a servant stands at attention at every door. It is a court. It is a small and quiet one. The stories that last are not about a monster. They are about a very old man in a very large house, who stood at windows and watched people go by. The children in the village say that he used to leave bread on the sill. Nobody can say who it was for.
